C1483.title: Jay Chou's BAYC NFT Theft Incident
C1483.summary: In April 2022, a Bored Ape Yacht Club (BAYC) NFT owned by singer Jay Chou was stolen through a phishing website, with the NFT valued at over 3.2 million RMB. The attacker gained wallet authorization by tricking the user, quickly transferred the asset, highlighting security risks of virtual assets like NFTs.
